notes.title: Update 10.01.25
notes.content:
[b]Оновлення:[/b]
1. Added support for such languages as:
   Ukrainian
   German
   Italian
   Spanish
   Portuguese
   Japanese
   Chinese
   French
   Polish
   Russian
2. An in-game tutorial has been added.
   It explains which buttons are responsible for what and shows a video example.
3. Added the ability to create private lobbies.
4. Added the ability to connect to the lobby by ID.
5. Added the ability to copy lobby identifiers.
6. Added the option to save the game when you enter the main menu.
7. Fixed game bugs found.
8. Added videos from players who played the game.

notes.title: Update 04/01
notes.content: Added a small tutorial when joining a level. A choice of difficulty level for solo play has been made. Added a description of the difficulty levels.

notes.title: 1st day fix
notes.content: Added a mouse sensitivity setting. Added “How to play” tab to the main menu. Made it easier to pass fans at the very beginning of the game. Fixed character teleport. Fixed minor details. Thanks to those who write reviews for our game, you help us to make the game better!
